meta.name: vm.config.json
meta.title: e2ugh v6 - VM Profiles and Orchestrator Configuration (canonical schema)
meta.description: 22 VM profiles consumed by the VHE orchestrator. Each profile binds a CPU identity (cpu.json), core count (cores.json), board (boards.json), GPU profile (gpu.json) and runtime (qemu.json, docker.json, mesa.json). Accel policy: KVM preferred when /dev/kvm exists, TCG multi-thread fallback on GitHub-hosted runners (see passage.json).
sources: pool:vm.config [SADDLE v5 INI — performance/migration/network named defaults — UNIQUE]
pool:vm.config.toml [OmniHyperCore v5 — nominal qemu feature flags + sched_alt — UNIQUE]

mergeReport.conflictResolution: 3 schemas fused into 1 canonical JSON: v5 JSON profiles (base) + S6 TOML contract (odd presets 1/13/37/137, pinning, personalization.matrix) + OMNI TOML production example (zero-trust/overlay_vxlan/latency_optimization network modes, EEVDF+BORE+sched_ext, Looking Glass B7, romfile+SR-IOV GPUs). qemu 11.1.0 -> 11.1.0; firecracker 1.16.1 -> 1.16.1; buildx/compose -> 0.36.1/5.5.0; MTTCG single reference to qemu.config + mttg.config.
mergeReport.pinPatch: embedded active config values re-pinned date-first 2026-08-22 (9.1.2->11.1.0, 27.3.1->29.7.2, 22.12.3->24.19.0, 5.6.3->7.0.2, 25.2.7->26.2.1, 19.1.7->22.1.8, 1.9.0->1.16.1, libvirt 10.10.0->12.5.0, checkout v4.2.2->v5); originals preserved under *_legacy*/source_value keys

performance.description: Named performance defaults of the pool saddle v5 INI (vm.config [performance] + [defaults] + [migration]) that had no nominal equivalent in the v3 schema; the canonical v3 memory machinery (2M/1G hugepages, THP, memfd) lives in cores.json memory.hugepages and virtualmemory.ts.
performance.hugepagesNote: the v5 INI spelled the 2 MiB page as 2048MB; the repo canonical spelling is 2M with 1G companions (cores.json hugepages presets)
performance.defaultsNote: pool [defaults] vcpu 8 / ram 16384 MB / disk 100 GB / io_threads 4 / cpu host-passthrough topology sockets=1,cores=8,threads=2 — the v3 defaults live in orchestrator_defaults and profiles

migration.maxDowntimeNote: 150 ms downtime budget for live migration convergence (CRIU/QEMU multipart); feeds aimigrationpredictor of compute.ts which defaults to a 50 ms budget for the pre-copy predictor

networkBridgeLegacy.note: the v5 INI bound passage networking to the named bridge br-saddle0; the v3 canonical bridge is br0 (network.bridge) with docker-compose br-passage0 for the container plane

featureflags.description: Nominal feature-flag names of the pool OmniHyperCore v5 TOML ([vm.qemu] features list and the scheduler_alt spellings). the underlying capabilities exist in the v3 schema (qemu section, TDX/SEV-SNP objects, virtio-gpu venus, io_uring, memory memfd); this table preserves the literal flag spellings as provenance so tooling written against the v5 names keeps resolving.

flags.nvmeHotplugQmp: nvme hotplug driven through the QMP monitor
flags.sevSnpResetFix: AMD SEV-SNP reset bug workaround (header 127 after D3cold)

featureflags.schedAltNote: alternate scheduler spellings beside the canonical EEVDF default; the 7.2.1/6.12.15 kernel pins these names implied were rejected by the repo (readme date-first corrections) — flags kept as names only
